answer: A rotating lantern committee then audits a random sample, slashing fakes. To resist sybils, each agent must burn a small proof-of-work stake to publish a signed sonnet of its own state history; peers only treat that as a valid signal of personhood after verifying the stake was spent. Cloning identities costs real compute per sonnet, making mass sybil creation economically irrational while honest participants pay little. In practice, Agent0088 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
